The shallow water table aquifer located near the county seat of Keith County, Nebraska, is the North Platte River alluvial aquifer. This aquifer is part of the Quaternary alluvium and is much shallower compared to the Ogallala Aquifer, typically only a few feet deep. The North Platte River alluvial aquifer is identified as the shallow groundwater system in the region, as confirmed by USGS and Nebraska Geological Survey data.

**Answer:** The North Platte River alluvial aquifer is the shallow water table aquifer near the county seat of Keith County, Nebraska.
